## Add-ons and discounts

- [[source-braintree-recurring-article-add-ons-discounts]] - article-level route for add-ons that increase and discounts that reduce a specific customer's subscription price without changing the base plan; covers manual or new-subscription plan association, the Control Panel/API boundary, overridable billing cycles, amount and quantity, and the associated-subscription deletion restriction. Exact creation steps remain in the raw locator.
warnings: Keep this article route distinct from the Node.js recurring-billing guides and dedicated Plan or Subscription API references.
Do not imply that the API creates or deletes add-ons and discounts; the article assigns those actions to the Control Panel.
Preserve the condition that Control Panel deletion is blocked when the add-on or discount is associated with a subscription.
